content:
Noah: Quick one 60s: customers keep asking why an SLO alert never fired. Console only shows "suppressed". We should show actionable context, not a black box.
Jin: yeah. Minimum: reason label + link to a decision artifact. Users can click and see exactly which rule suppressed it.
Camila: also show the "effective notify chance" number. If sampling reduced notify to 2%, that's the explanation 90% of the time.
Priya: agree. On the API side I propose storing a compact decision record per evaluated event with TTL 14d. Fields: decision_id, event_id, policy_refs, matched, sample_pct, seed, actor, created_at.
Noah: shorter TTL than 30d ok (less storage). But keep the replay determinism story: if people call replay we need same randomness. persisting seed is simplest.
Jin: +1. We should sign the record (HMAC) so console can trust it when served from caches. That avoids stale-manipulation concerns.
Camila: UX: Console row shows small badge: "suppressed (sampled 2%)"; hover expands to "matched: quiet-window, dedupe, sampled(0.02)" and an anchor "view decision".
Priya: API proposals: GET /v1/slo/decisions/{decision_id} and POST /v1/slo/replay/{decision_id} (auth required). Replay should return deterministic outcome and the explain_chain.
Jin: telemetry event name: `slo.decision.logged` with fields: decision_id, event_id, policy_id(s), sample_pct, matched_rules, rollout_tag, result (suppressed/notify). Publish to our events pipeline.
Noah: concerning performance: decision record writes happen on the hot path. Keep record small (<1KB). Store pointers to policy versions rather than full blobs.
Camila: Policy versioning: include policy_version_id in the record so future audits can fetch the exact policy snapshot.
Priya: security: replay endpoint needs a new scope `slo:replay` and we log replay actions to audit with user, ip, and reason. Bypass (force-notify) must be auditable and gated.
Jin: for the UI "force notify" flow: modal explains this will create a one-off notification and is recorded. Button disabled for non-admins.
Camila: small example record (compact):
```
{
  "decision_id":"d_6b3f9",
  "event_id":"e_20260321_42",
  "policy_refs":["p:latency-v2"],
  "matched":["threshold","quiet-window","sampled"],
  "sample_pct":"0.02",
  "seed":"0x5f3a",
  "policy_version":"pv_20260320_9",
  "result":"suppressed",
  "created_at":"2026-03-21T15:20:00Z"
}
```
Priya: storage note: use compressed protobuf for the persisting layer. We'll index by event_id and decision_id. Use a short TTL and background retention export for audits.
Noah: telemetry-driven UX: show "expected notify rate vs actual" timeseries for the alert route in the Console to surface sampling impact.
Jin: also add a small flag in the Decision API `can_force` to indicate whether this decision is eligible for force-notify (respecting quiet-windows and perms).
Camila: rollout: toggle the new tooltip + decision link behind a feature flag default-on for internal tenants first. We'll collect feedback.
Priya: action list: (1) infra: proto + store + HMAC signing + TTL (Priya/Jin) (2) events: slo.decision.logged schema + pipeline hook (Jin) (3) console: badge/hover/detail panel + replay modal + audit UX (Camila) (4) security: scopes + audit logging (Noah)
infra-bot: deploy plan queued: `slo-decision-writer` v1 -> canary group alpha-2, watch `slo.decision.logged` for anomalies.
Noah: cool. Let's meet in 1h with drafts for proto and Console mockups. :white_check_mark:
